description: Hydropower reservoirs in Cambodia (1999-2010) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset describes the information of hydropower reservoirs for each of Cambodia’s province from 2009 to 2010. The data was collected from many sources by ODC’s mappers such as government and NGO agency in pdf format. Geographic data is encoded in the WGS 84, Zone 48 North coordinate reference system. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Energy, Rivers and lakes, Water resources, Water rights. It offers 9 resource(s) in csv, jpeg, json, kml, wms. The portal shows 2020-01-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
